text.feels_intro: How the poison in {name} feels right now; let this shape {his} tone, posture and movement:
text.feels_outro: Answer must be creative and different, repetition will be punished.

head: {name}'s face: flushed and sweating, a faint greenish tinge around {his} lips.
{name}'s face: sickly grey-green and slick with cold sweat, dark veins creeping along {his} jaw and temples, the eyes bloodshot. A sour, bitter smell is on {his} breath.
{name}'s face: mottled green and black, veins swollen and dark under the skin, lips blue and flecked with froth, pupils huge. A rank, bitter stench of sickness and vomit clings to {him}.
body: {name}'s back: a small angry mark where the poison went in, the skin hot and reddened around it.
{name}'s back: dark green-black veins spreading out from the poisoned spot, the skin clammy and swollen. A bitter chemical smell rises from it.
{name}'s back: blackened veins branching across the whole torso, the flesh swollen, blistered and weeping. {name} reeks of sweat, bile and rot.
arm: {name}'s {part}: a red, swollen mark, hot to the touch.
{name}'s {part}: swollen and discoloured, dark veins creeping up toward the shoulder, the fingers twitching.
{name}'s {part}: black-veined and bloated, the skin blistering and weeping foul fluid; the hand is clenched in a cramp.
leg: {name}'s {part}: a red, swollen mark, hot to the touch.
{name}'s {part}: swollen and discoloured, dark veins climbing toward the hip, the muscle twitching.
{name}'s {part}: black-veined and bloated, the flesh blistering and weeping; the leg is locked in a cramp.

head: {name} feels hot, queasy and a little dizzy. {name} swallows hard and wipes {his} brow.
{name} feels the poison throbbing in {his} skull; {his} vision blurs, {his} mouth tastes of metal and {he} keeps retching. {name} slurs {his} words.
{name} feels {his} head pounding and the world spinning, {his} throat closing and {his} tongue thick. {name} can barely speak, retching and gasping.
body: {name} feels a burning sting and a sick, churning stomach. {name} is uneasy and pale.
{name} feels cramps knotting {his} belly and chest and cold sweat pouring off {him}; {he} gags. {name} hunches over, shaking.
{name} feels the poison in every vein; {his} heart races and stumbles, {his} gut heaves and {his} muscles seize. {name} is convulsing and terrified.
arm: {name}'s {part} stings and tingles. {name} rubs at it.
{name}'s {part} burns and cramps, the fingers twitching and weak. {name} holds it close.
{name}'s {part} is locked in agonising cramps and numb at the fingertips. {name} cannot use it.
leg: {name}'s {part} stings and tingles. {name} favours it slightly.
{name}'s {part} burns and cramps and shakes under {his} weight. {name} limps, sweating.
{name}'s {part} is seized in agonising cramps and will not bear weight. {name} collapses when {he} tries to stand.

levels: , a burning sting as the poison seeps into the flesh. {name} winces, skin flushing hot around it.
, the poison seeping into flesh already sick with it. Dark veins spread under {name}'s skin; {name} gags and sweats, swaying.
, and the venom floods through {name}'s veins. {name} doubles over retching, muscles knotting in cramps, face turning grey-green.
, and it is too much. The poison takes hold of {name}'s heart; {name} convulses, froth on {name}'s lips, and sinks down choking.

start.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}, beginning to heal {own} wounds and pain.
start.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light, beginning to heal {own} wounds and pain.

start_unhurt.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}. With no wounds to mend, it simply washes over {obj}, warm and soothing.
start_unhurt.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light. With no wounds to mend, it simply feels warm and soothing.

pain_gone.none: The pain from {name}'s injuries is gone, but the healing continues.
pain_gone.source: The warm light of {owner_lc} {noun} has taken the pain from {own} injuries, but the healing continues.

full.none: {name}'s injuries are now fully healed, leaving {name} without pain or blemish.
full.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}. {name}'s injuries are now fully healed, leaving {name} without pain or blemish.
full.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light. {name}'s injuries are now fully healed, leaving {name} without pain or blemish.

heal_events.stopped: The warm light of {owner_lc} {noun} fades before the healing is done; {own} injuries are {progress}.

head: the poison reaches {name}'s brain; {name}'s eyes roll back, blood trickles from the nose, and {name} thrashes in a fit, jaw locked and froth bubbling at the lips, until the body goes rigid and still.
{name}'s throat swells shut from the poison; {name} claws at it, face going purple and black-veined, and dies choking, lips blue and wet with froth and vomit.
body: the poison stops {name}'s heart; {name} clutches at the chest, vomits black bile, and falls convulsing, limbs jerking until they finally stiffen and lie still.
{name}'s gut and lungs fill with the venom; {name} retches blood and bile, doubles over in cramps and drops, twitching, the bitter stench of poison and vomit rising from the body.
arm: the black veins race from {name}'s {part} to the heart; {name} seizes, arm locked rigid, and collapses foaming at the mouth, shaking until the poison has done its work.
the poison swells {name}'s {part} black and bloated and floods the body; {name} vomits, convulses, and dies on the ground, fingers clawed in a final cramp.
leg: the poison climbs from {name}'s {part} through the body; {name}'s legs give way, {name} retches and thrashes in the dirt, and the convulsions stop only when {name}'s heart does.
{name}'s {part} turns black and bloated as the venom spreads; {name} falls gasping, skin grey-green and slick, and dies shuddering, froth on the lips.

soil: As {name}'s body goes slack, the stink of {name}'s shit and piss mixes with the blood.
In death {name}'s bowels and bladder let go, and the stench of shit and piss joins the smell of blood.
